title: Cavolo nero and bacon stuffed jackets

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, bacon, butter, garlic, greens, cabbage, cider vinegar, crème fraîche and cheddar are all ordinary home-kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including cavolo nero, is stocked by mainstream supermarkets like Tesco at an everyday price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a frying pan and a bowl, and the technique is simple baking, frying and mashing.

works.reason: Four large potatoes with 200g bacon and 400g wilted cavolo nero make a good lunch for four, with a sensible oven temperature, timings and seasoning.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes covers the chopping, shredding, grating and mashing, and the 90 minutes matches the 75-minute bake plus the 15-minute second bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot, cheesy stuffed jacket suits a December lunch, and 400g of cavolo nero is the heart of the filling.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potato, bacon, plenty of greens, cheese and a raw red cabbage salad make a filling meal of real food that a family would enjoy.
